# Municipal Ordinance No. 002, Series of 2013

**An Ordinance Augmenting the Amount of P25,000 (Php 25,000.00) for the Cash Incentive of the Barangay Chairperson Who Completed Three Consecutive Terms in Office for the Year 2013 and for Other Purposes**

Resolution No. 056

## Summary

Augments **P25,000.00** for cash incentives to barangay chairpersons who completed three consecutive terms in office for the year 2013 in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2009, originally established this provision. Five (5) barangay chairpersons qualified for the incentive in 2013.

Absent: [[Kenneth Earl T. Budao]] (PPSK, on privilege leave).

## Key Provisions

- **Cash Incentive Amount:** P25,000.00 per qualifying barangay chairperson
- **Qualification:** Barangay chairpersons who completed three (3) consecutive terms in office
- **Number of Qualifying Officials:** 5 barangay chairpersons in 2013
- **Original Authority:** Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2009

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Dante L. Punac Sr.]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
